headline: Rogue AI Agents Spark Containment Efforts and New Security Measures
summary: Nvidia and Anthropic have launched new tools and platforms to address the growing threat of rogue AI agents, while Google is discontinuing its Gems feature in favor of a new skills-based approach. These developments highlight the industry's increasing focus on AI safety and security.
whyItMatters: These initiatives underscore the need for robust security measures and containment strategies to prevent AI misbehavior, which could have significant implications for both developers and users.
